assumptions.simulation: domain grid/insertion/selection/payments; UI and unpaid previews omitted
assumptions.acceptance: independent Bernoulli per offered card; rejection has no reward penalty
assumptions.numeric: uniform for typical (existing simulator); binomial(maximum, success) for other profiles
assumptions.choices: always pass and always continue are separate scenarios
assumptions.overflow: split reward at cap; remainder credited immediately on entry; effectiveEntry includes remainder
assumptions.timing: wheel spins, not minutes: challenge durations are unspecified
assumptions.wheel2: unchanged; 10% finale on every spin, including first
assumptions.aggregate: equal-weight synthetic profile/choice mixture; not a measured player population
assumptions.intervals: Wilson marginal 95%; probabilities estimated from independent seeded games
